Strictly maintain their exact 3D Pixar facial features. Setting is a vibrant Indian living room with morning sunlight. Foji Makra wears an olive green PT tracksuit. Fojan Meera wears a colorful yellow Anarkali suit. [0.0s - 4.0s]: Foji Makra does jumping jacks and speaks clearly in Hindi at natural brisk pace: 'सुबह का पीटी शुरू, फौजी स्टाइल में!'. [4.0s - 8.0s]: Fojan Meera hands him a broom with an attitude and replies clearly in Hindi before the video ends: 'पहले झाड़ू उठाओ, फौजी साहब!'. [8.0s - 10.0s]: Both hold an expressive cinematic reaction/smile so the audio never cuts off abruptly. Add subtle Bollywood funny background instrumental music beneath the clear Hindi character voices.
